## Parent truck system
Link the parent system issue and add this issue as a sub-issue.

## Scope and evidence
Exact application, references, measured dimensions and known unknowns.

## Interface contract
Units, coordinate frame, mounting datums, neighbors and owned files.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Parametric CAD, STEP/GLB and component learning page
- [ ] Source-image comparison and explicit fidelity limits
- [ ] Dimensions, contacts, clearance and relevant motion/flow checks
- [ ] Browser and integrated assembly verification
- [ ] Reproducible reports and integration handoff
